description: Use for one finwire index with history. Find the id with list_finwire_indices. Give the id and the method version from the citation field. One finwire index by its id finwire_* (old dataset ids such as credit-market-index, borrowing-power or credit-stress are accepted as aliases): latest and previous reading with periods, change, method version, sources, citation formula and history. Indices computed from WIBOR publish only the result.

id.description: finwire_* id or alias from list_finwire_indices, for example "finwire_entry_threshold_index".

name: get_finwire_index
title: One finwire index with history
